newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Abbey up amid talk of Lloyds TSB move.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Abbey up amid talk of Lloyds TSB move.

text.p: Shares in life insurer Lloyds Abbey Life gained in early Friday trade amid press reports that Lloyds TSB -- which already owns a substantial stake in the insurer -- may be about to pounce again, analysts said.
One report in a British newspaper said Lloyds TSB was ready to put up 700 pence in cash and shares for the remaining 37.4 percent stake in Lloyds Abbey.
"Its the same old rumour -- Lloyds TSB is thinking of taking up the rest of the stock," said one analyst at Japanese bank.
Lloyds Abbey stock pushed to a high at 604 pence in early trade, but soon eased off to trade 7-1/2 at 599-1/2 by 0807 GMT.
Shares in Lloyds TSB were up three pence on the day at 394 by the same time.
